why: At 0:16-0:26 the tie hangs around the raised collar with the wide end on his right reaching below the belt and the narrow end on his left ending at the belt.

edits.say: Grab the long wide end on your right. Cross it over the front of the narrow end, right up under your collar, to make an X.
placements: dark blue wide end → diagonally over the front of the narrow end, just below the collar at the throat, forming an X

why: 0:28-0:36 is talking to camera. The cross happens at 0:38-0:40, high under the collar, not at mid-chest. By 0:42-0:44 the wide end is already wrapping, and the step-2 end frame shows the wrap, so 45 s is too late. Note: done_looks_like, check_yourself and watch_for still say 'mid-chest' and should say 'just below the collar'.
At 0:42-0:46 the wide end goes behind the narrow end and back across the front, horizontally to his right. The band is finished by 0:48.

At 0:48-0:54 the wide end comes up from underneath through the neck loop. At 0:56 it is already hanging down in front. The old end of 60 s overlapped the front-loop tuck at 0:58 (step-4 end frame shows that tuck).
At 0:58-1:00 the wide tip is pushed down through the front band and at 1:02 the knot is formed and pulled snug. From 1:04 he slides the knot up, which belongs to step 6.

At 1:04-1:08 he holds the narrow end and slides the knot up to the collar. At 1:10-1:14 he folds the collar down and centres the knot. 1:16-1:20 is a finished-tie close-up and the Howcast outro starts at 1:22.
